propositions: The criteria eval CLI preflight currently rejects code-review criterion ids as unknown because it only checks the plan-review registry, preventing activated project code-review criteria from reaching the gate-aware eval resolver.
The preflight must be extended to admit code-review ids by looking them up in both plan-review and code-review effective registries and resolving to the target gate deterministically.

An id active in exactly one gate should be admitted and dispatched to that gate's calibrate path; an id active in both gates should be rejected as ambiguous; an id in neither should return the existing unknown error.
The criteria eval help text must be updated to include a concrete code-review example (project.foo) alongside the existing plan-review example.
